results.rationale: The cited capabilities are unrelated project references and do not provide any evidence addressing the tender’s mandatory eligibility/compliance condition itself.

We can evidence completion of at least two solar energy projects (CAP-008, CAP-044, CAP-032), but the requirement depends on meeting specific contract value thresholds from RFP table M1 which are not evidenced here.
ISO 9001 certification is explicitly evidenced by multiple capabilities (e.g., CAP-030, CAP-022, CAP-039) matching the required standard.
Prior work with Pakistan federal/provincial government clients is evidenced via projects for Federal Govt and Provincial Govt (e.g., CAP-003, CAP-002, CAP-049).
No evidence is provided of submitting a 2% bid security in the form of a bank guarantee from a scheduled bank (an administrative bid document requirement).
PMP certification is evidenced (CAP-005, CAP-027), but there is no evidence of the named project manager’s minimum 8 years of infrastructure project experience.
There is no documentary evidence of FBR registration or an active taxpayer certificate (an administrative/legal registration requirement).
The provided solar project references do not evidence Tier-1 modules, ≥21% efficiency, or a 25-year linear performance warranty as specified.
